headline: Fun little offshore morning, then the good stuff lines up later in the week.
today: Waist-to-chest ESE with N offshore through the morning — short period but clean, so grab a log or fish and enjoy the glassy early session. Wind swings cross ENE/E by afternoon and softens it up. Best window is dawn to late morning.

daysToWatch.note: Big on paper (to 6ft, prime angle) but 24mph SE onshore has it blown out. Watch the swell, not the surf — likely a washout.
Head-high-plus at a prime angle with cross-off wind, but it's screaming 27mph NNE. Big and rough — for the experienced only.
Head-high 6-7s prime SSE with light cross morning wind cleaning up. This is the day to rearrange plans for — shortboard.
Still 3-4ft at a good angle with light ENE cross morning. Another fun one before the afternoon onshore.
